comparison.objective: Stabilize a paint tin, pry three rim tabs, remove its lid, and return the tool; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization, claw insertion, sequential prying, and lid handling versus hex-key seating, collar tuning, relocking, and response-guided cycling.
comparison.success_condition: All tabs raised, lid removed, tin not tipped, and tool returned versus two safe repeatable stops and retained setting.
comparison.reason: They share bimanual tool use but test different contact mechanics and outcomes. No spec versions or numeric tab/tilt thresholds were available.
